title: Musical relatives and his family's Jackson, Mississippi roots
summary: Only an uncle who played trap drums in Jackson was musical; his father came to Chicago at six.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Ten years old. Was anyone besides your uncle musical, that you know of, in your family?
Not that I know of. I had -- my uncle played drums. Played what they called trap drums.
The same uncle that had the violin?
Yeah. So far as I know.
Is that where your family's from?
That's where my family's from, yeah.
I was born in Chicago, yeah.
When did your family come to Chicago, do you know?
Oh, I don't know exactly. My father came to Chicago when he was six years old, and that was just
So you're really a long generation Chicagoan?
